en.topic_title: US, China buy time with trade truce as pressure builds
en.topic_summary:
By Beiyi Seow



Washington and Beijing may have bought themselves breathing space with an extended trade truce, but analysts warn that time is running out for the world’s two biggest economies to resolve their strategic rivalry.



Chinese President Xi Jinping (right) ​paid a state visit ‌to the US between September 23 and 25 at the invitation of President Donald Trump (right). Photo: White House.



President Donald Trump and Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping concluded a pomp-filled summit
